lines: We are the servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand.
We are the servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us man-flesh to eat.
Rest while you can, fool!
I smell man-flesh!
The age of the orc has come.
The Horse-country will burn!
I've had nothing but maggoty bread for three stinking days!
The world will burn in the fires of industry!
The realms of men shall burn!
Where is the man-flesh?
What do you want?
Maggoty bread again? Give me some Man-flesh!
I can't wait to get my teeth into some Man-flesh!
Soon, soon we will be at war with the filthy sons of Men!
What are you after?
We shall break their bones and feast on their flesh!
Death to the kingdoms of Men! Death to the filthy Elves!
We shall swarm into the lands of the free peoples like a plague! Leave nothing alive!
The world of Men shall be broken and destroyed.
Ruin! Ruin to the free peoples!
I don’t trust you little swine, you’ve no guts outside your own sties.
If I had my way, you’d wish you were dead now.
I bet you'd give good sport!
You aren't one of them cursed horse-men are you?
Do you serve the White Hand?
Filthy maggot!
What about your legs? You don't need those! Oh, they look tasty!
I could gut you right where you stand!
What're you looking at?
Get your crooked nose out of my face!
You lost, maggot?
I smell your fear.
I could smell your stench a mile away!
You reek!
These rags stink!
Something smells disgusting here. It's you! Go away!
What are you after, maggot?
Follow your orders, scum!
Don't just stand there! Do something!
Whom do you serve?
Move along, scum!
Are you trying to start a fight?
You stink!
I don't trust you, maggot!
I don't trust filthy Men!
You one of them men from the hills?
Do you serve the White Hand, or those filthy Horse-men?
U bagronk sha pushdug Saruman-glob búbhosh skai!
You're a filthy maggot, #p!
Get your crooked nose out of my face, #p!
You lost, #p?
You reek #p!
You still don't look like a Goblin-man, #p!
Filthy maggot! Oh, it's you, #p...
Soon, #p! Soon we will be at war with the filthy sons of Men!
Soon, #p! Soon we will be at war with the filthy sons of Men!
You're not bad for a Man!
The Master is readying us for war. Soon the world of Men shall fall.
We shall swarm into the lands of the free peoples like a plague! Leave nothing alive!
Haven't seen you around here before.
Don't choke on the air, filth.
Get back to work maggot!
Shouldn't you be in the mines?
You ought to go back where you came from.
The air is foul here.
Quiet! We can't let those cursed horse-boys get wind of us.
Death! Death to the horse-lords!
I smell fear in the air.
Have you seen any Halflings? They ought to be coming through these lands here soon.
I love horse-flesh almost as much as I love man-flesh!
The air is ripe with the stink of fear!
Burn every village!
Leave nothing alive!
Burn every village, leave none alive!
Death to the horse-men!
Burn every field, gut every horse!
Kill not just the men, but the women and children too!
Soon, this land will be ours!
Victory is at hand!
The Golden Hall will burn!
I love the stench of fear!
I'm tired of cutting these stinking trees!
We ought to just burn down this whole forest!
Did that tree just move?
Get to work, the White Hand needs more wood for the forges!
Every night more orc scum goes missing in the forest.
I hate this stinking forest.
Something's not right with this filthy wood.
